title: Painting to the cast iron Lighthouse Tower, 30m High Aerial Mast trestle towers (02) and Navtex trestle tower (01) at Keating Point Lighthouse & DGPS Station, Car Nicobar
summary: Online item-rate two-cover e-tender for repainting the cast iron lighthouse tower, two 30 m DGPS aerial mast trestle towers and the Navtex trestle tower at Keating Point Lighthouse & DGPS Station, Car Nicobar. The work also includes GI flats at ladder landings and a GI framed door shutter. Issued by the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Port Blair.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Port Blair

sites.name: Keating Point Lighthouse & DGPS Station, Car Nicobar
sites.work: Painting of cast iron lighthouse tower (exterior, interior, chequered plates), two 30 m DGPS aerial mast trestle towers and Navtex trestle tower; GI flats at ladder landings; GI framed door shutter

scope.item: Painting exterior surface of lighthouse tower at all heights with synthetic enamel paint in two coats over a coat of primer, after cleaning with alkaline solution and scraping
Painting interior surface of lighthouse tower at all heights with synthetic enamel paint in two coats after cleaning and scraping
Painting metallic chequered plates in staircase landings of lighthouse tower with synthetic enamel paint in two coats
Synthetic enamel painting (Asian/Berger/Dulux/Nerolac high glossy, two or more coats) of previously painted surface of 30 m aerial mast trestle tower - DGPS Aerial Mast Towers (325 Sqm each)
Synthetic enamel painting of Aerial Mast for Navtex at Keating Point lighthouse and DGPS Station (325 sqm)
Providing and fixing G.I flat 40x6 mm at all landings of ladder inside lighthouse including welding, clamping and priming coat
Providing & fixing G.I framed door shutter (GI L angles 50x50x6 mm, GI flat 40x6 mm lugs, aluminium sheet not less than 3 mm) to cast iron lighthouse tower as per drawing

money.performance_security: 5% of contract value (performance bank guarantee valid six months beyond completion); plus 5% security deposit deducted from running and final bills
money.notes: Estimated cost inclusive of GST and labour cess; BOQ amounts inclusive of all taxes. EMD by Deposit at call receipt / FDR of nationalized/scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Port Blair; original to reach office by 15/05/2024 15:00. MSME/NSIC registered bidders for similar (civil) work exempt from EMD. Bid document free of cost. Liquidated damages 1% per week, max 10% of estimated cost.

period.bid_validity: 180 days from date of opening of technical bid
period.warranty: Contractor to maintain the lighthouse tower for 12 months from completion (defect liability)

eligibility: Experienced civil contractors with similar works completed for Government organizations in A & N Islands in last seven years, without adverse remarks
Three similar works each >= 40% of estimated cost (Rs 5.69 lakh), or two each >= 60% (Rs 8.53 lakh), or one >= 80% (Rs 11.38 lakh)
Similar works = painting of cast iron lighthouse towers / aerial mast towers / trestle towers / masonry / RCC towers in Andaman and Nicobar Islands
Average annual turnover over last three years ending 31 March 2023 at least Rs 4.27 lakh, CA certified

GST and PAN registration; unconditional bid undertaking with list of relatives serving in MoPSW/DGLL; notarised non-blacklisting affidavit on Rs 100 stamp paper (Annexure V); tender acceptance letter (Annexure III); details of civil engineers with firm

Technical evaluation out of 100 marks (experience 60, turnover 15, documents 10, personnel 10, plant & equipment 5); minimum 60% aggregate to open commercial bid; lowest rate among qualified bidders wins
specs: All work per CPWD specifications, otherwise Indian Standards
Synthetic enamel paint conforming to IS 2933; approved makes for paints & primers: Asian / Berger or equivalent approved by DLL Port Blair (BOQ item 4 also lists Dulux/Nerolac)
Shades: snow white / brilliant white and signal red for trestle towers and CI tower; bus green for automation box and handrail; black for gate, pedestal
Site-in-charge graduate engineer (2 yrs) or diploma engineer (5 yrs); Rs 25,000 per month recovery if not deployed
Door shutter drawing: GI sheet 3.15 mm front & back, GI angle 50x50x6 mm frame, GI flat 40x6 mm bracing
notes: Fully scanned 73-page tender document, no text layer. Read from images: cover, index, Section I NIT (Hindi and English), Section III eligibility, Section IV GCC samples, Section V special conditions, Section VI specifications, Section VII BOQ, Section VIII evaluation, Annexures I-II and the door shutter drawing (page 73). Remaining GCC pages and blank labour register / muster roll forms (pages 56-72) were sampled as boilerplate only. BOQ is printed without rates; Section VII is headed 'Uploaded Separately'. Internal inconsistencies: (1) Annexure I gives EMD as 'Rs. 28,500/- (Rupees Forty-Seven Thousand and Seven Hundred Only)'. (2) EMD validity is 06 months in the NIT but 180 days in Annexure I. (3) Two-work experience threshold is 60% (not the usual 50%). Dates: NIT 30/04/2024; download/submission 30/04/2024 17:00 to 15/05/2024 15:00; bid queries by 08/05/2024 12:00; pre-bid 08/05/2024 15:00 at DLL Port Blair; technical bid opening 16/05/2024 15:00.
